programmes.d: Lucy Alexander & Martin Roberts visit a two bedroomed end of terrace property in Rochester, Kent, a 1970s three bed-roomed house in Derbyshire & a flat in Eastbourne.
Martin & Lucy visit a three bed end-of-terrace in Sheffield, a flat in Bayswater, London and a property in St Helens, Merseyside.
Martin & Lucy visit a building plot in Derbyshire, a flat in south London and a bungalow in Lanarkshire.

Martin and Lucy visit a house in Ashbourne, Derbyshire which is full of original Victorian details, a two bedroom bungalow near Reading where the land it sits on is the icing on the cake and there are some questions at a end of terrace house in Wales.
Martin and Lucy view properties in West London, Staffordshire and Kent.
Martin & Lucy visit a 3 bedroom semi in Cornwall, a one bedroom flat in London and a house in Gwent.
Lucy Alexander & Martin Roberts visit a cottage in Dorset with an unusual addition, an old telephone exchange in Devon and a three bed-roomed house in Addlestone, Surrey.
Martin and Lucy visit a property in Dorset with plenty of original features, a house in Hertfordshire and revisit a plot of land we first visited in 2005 to see the end result.

Martin and Lucy visit a colourful flat in Cheshire, in Battersea, London Lucy gets more than she bargained for when she visits a flat and in Staffordshire Martin looks round a house in need of total remodernisation.
Martin and Lucy visit a \\"land of opportunity\\" in Kent, the grade 2 listed property in Berkshire and a railway cottage in West Yorkshire that's on track to be a winner.
Martin and Lucy visit a plot of land in Hampshire, an end-of-terrace cottage in Derbyshire and a dingy one-bedroom flat in London.
Martin and Lucy visit a property in Stoke-on Trent with a tiny kitchen, a block of bedsits in London and revisit a 400 year old listed house in Wiltshire.
Martin and Lucy visit a property in Cornwall, a 1950's property in Middlesex and a house in Wales.
Martin & Lucy visit a flat in London, a mysterious house in Newcastle- Under-Lyme and a property in the seaside town of Ramsgate with a water problem.
Martin and Lucy visit a tired and dated semi in Telford, a flat in Margate and return to a magnificent 16 th century house in Derbyshire we first visited 4 ½ years ago.
Martin & Lucy visit a semi detached house in Wootton Bassett, Wiltshire, a three bed terrace in Tonbridge, Kent and a house in Dawley, Shropshire.
Martin & Lucy visit a house in Dorset that's full of surprises, a property on Portobello Road in London and a cottage in Newquay.
Lucy and Martin are hooked on a modern Welsh property, in Kent the clues look good for a Sidcup semi and in the basement of a Harrogate house there's a very cramped one bed flat.
Martin & Lucy visit a four bed end-of-terrace in need of modernisation in Greater Manchester, a studio apartment in Notting Hill and a cottage in Devon.
Martin & Lucy visit a flat in south London that could benefit from more than just cosmetic surgery, a house in a prime location in Herne Bay and a mid terrace near a main road in Derby.
Martin & Lucy visit a property in Maida Vale, a former stable in Wiltshire and two bed semi in Lincolnshire.
